text:
Maya (Finance): FYI — reconciliation job flagged ~120 invoices not present in NetSuite but Stripe shows them PAID. Started at 03:10 UTC. Can someone help investigate?

Raj (Backend): Do we have webhook delivery errors around that window? Which job reported the mismatch?

billing-bot: ALERT: webhook-delivery failures detected for /webhooks/netsuite 03:09:54 - 03:21:10 UTC (502/504 spike). Failed events: 118. See /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742301123

Noah (Payments): Example Stripe event: evt_1KzXx2ABcD3E7fGHIjklmno - payment_intent.succeeded. Payload shows metadata: {"external_invoice_id":"inv-2026-03-23-87"}. I can paste full payload if useful.

Sasha (Ops): We shipped a small change to billing-sync yesterday that tightened signature verification (switched to strict HMAC timestamp enforcement) and rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Might be related.

Maya (Finance): If they didn't verify, NetSuite would never see the create calls. But Stripe recorded payments and customers are asking for invoices. Need priority fix and a plan to backfill.

Raj (Backend): Pulling logs now. Error seen in billing-sync at 03:12:07: 
```
ERROR billing-sync: webhook verification failed. event=evt_1KzXx2ABcD3; sig_header=sha256=abc123...; expected=sha256=def456...
Trace: SignatureVerificationError: timestamp outside tolerance
```
Looks like signature timestamp tolerance rejected a batch of events after secret rotation.

Noah (Payments): That matches — we rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET at 02:58 UTC and forgot to update the Stripe endpoint config with the new signing secret. Stripe kept sending with old secret until it expired, then signatures mismatched.

Sasha (Ops): I've re-applied the previous secret as a fallback to the webhook verifier (temporary) and restarted billing-sync. Monitoring now. Will keep for 15m while we re-run recon.

Raj (Backend): Thanks. I'm also adding a fallback verification path that tries both current and previous secret for 24h window. Pushing as hotfix to prod in 2m.

billing-bot: DEPLOYMENT: billing-sync v2.14.3-hotfix deployed by Raj at 03:28 UTC. Health checks passing.

Maya (Finance): Can someone confirm which invoices were blocked so we can reconcile customer notifications? I need list of Stripe event ids + our internal invoice ids.

Noah (Payments): Dumping sample of 20 of the 118 events to the backfill queue now. We'll dedupe by Stripe event id and external_invoice_id before creating in NetSuite. Also flagged potential duplicate external_id collisions in NS due to partial create attempts — we may need NetSuite help to clear partial records.

Sasha (Ops): Opened vendor ticket with NetSuite support, referencing partial create failures and unique key collisions. Ticket: NS-9832. Requesting they unlock conflicting external_id values and provide guidance to safely re-run creates.

Raj (Backend): Note for the runbook: the NetSuite API returns 409 on external_id duplicate, but our previous logic treated 409 as retryable and re-sent create leading to duplicates in partial states. I'll change logic to treat 409 as idempotent failure and fetch existing record instead.

Noah (Payments): I'll run the manual backfill once Raj confirms the 2-secret verifier is live AND NetSuite support confirms it's safe to re-run. ETA for backfill: 30-45m after green light.

Maya (Finance): OK please also produce an exceptions CSV (stripe_event, internal_invoice_id, customer_email, amount, status) so CS can triage open disputes.

Sasha (Ops): Sharing quick diagnostics: 
```
03:11:58 billing-sync incoming webhook: evt_1KzXx2ABcD3
03:12:07 billing-sync error: SignatureVerificationError (timestamp tolerance)
03:12:09 billing-sync retry 1 -> rejected
03:15:40 netsuite-api create attempt -> HTTP 500 (partial create)
03:16:10 netsuite-api rollback -> constraint violation external_id_exists
```

Raj (Backend): Patch is in. Verified for 2 secrets (current + previous). Also logging the raw Stripe header for auditing.

billing-bot: JOB: reconciliation-backfill queued (job_id=rb-1742301123-1).

Noah (Payments): Backfill started at 03:42 UTC (manual trigger). Running against dedupe flow. Posting progress in thread.

Sasha (Ops): NetSuite support replied: will clear 12 partial records in 1-2 hours; recommended we hold additional retries until clear. They've been assigned case NS-9832.

Maya (Finance): Sounds good. Please post a short postmortem once resolved — include root cause (secret rotation + strict verifier + retry logic bug), customer impact (# invoices delayed), remediation steps (fallback secret + change 409 handling + vendor cleanup), and follow-ups (alerting for secret rotations, automated secret sync with Stripe).

Raj (Backend): Will draft postmortem. Immediate follow-ups: 1) add pre-rotation checklist for webhook secrets, 2) change retry policy for create->409, 3) add automated unit test that simulates signature rotation.

Noah (Payments): Progress update: backfill processed 118 events, 106 created fine, 12 blocked (waiting NetSuite cleanup). No duplicate charges found. CSV exported to /finance/recon/ops/1742301123-delayed_invoices.csv.

Sasha (Ops): Ops note: set alert rule to trigger if webhook verification failures > 10 within 5m for /webhooks/netsuite. Also added a slack hook to #eng-oncall.

Maya (Finance): Thanks everyone. I'll notify CS about the 12 pending invoices and include the export. Please post when NetSuite confirms cleanup and when the postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: RESOLVED: webhook delivery error spike ended 03:55 UTC. Monitoring until 04:30 UTC.
